address: via del Falcone (spiaggia delle Viste), Portoferraio, 57037, Italy
bio: Leaving the port area, you climb toward the historic area of the Medici fortresses and then descend again along the opposite side until you reach a small beach. Here you’ll find the restaurant, charmingly and characteristically simple, right in front of the water’s edge. The cuisine is pleasantly traditional and essentially offers classic Italian seafood dishes....
